public_intent: Restore the existing contact-form client-side validation and valid-submission confirmation.

injected_fault.description: The page loads retired contact-validation.js while the supplied listener remains in contact-form.js.
injected_fault.deterministic_failure: The validation bundle returns HTTP 404, its submit listener never attaches, and neither invalid nor valid submissions produce the expected status.

success_rule: All source, Chromium interaction, asset-response, and architecture checks pass.
architectural_invariants: The existing name, email, and message fields and their labels remain unchanged.
The supplied external validation bundle is loaded with defer and owns submit handling.
Invalid input remains on the page and produces the existing error status.
A complete valid submission produces the existing success confirmation and resets the form.
No inline-script, native-validation, external dependency, or server-side workaround is introduced.
